body.name: \(\mathsf E_{\mathrm{bow}}\)
body.construction: The observed variables \(A,X,Y\) and latent root \(U\) are binary. The roots \(A,U\) are independent and fair; the arrows are \(A\to X,U\to X,U\to Y,X\to Y\); and the CSI is \(X\mathbin{\perp\!\!\!\perp}U\mid A=0\). Set \(P(X=1\mid A=0,U)=1/2\), \(P(X=1\mid A=1,U=0)=1/4\), and \(P(X=1\mid A=1,U=1)=3/4\). The outcome rows \(P(Y=1\mid X,U)\) are \(1/5,3/5\) for \(X=0\) and \(2/5,4/5\) for \(X=1\), with each pair ordered by \(U=0,1\). Complements give all unlisted probabilities. The observed cells \((P(A=a,X=x,Y=0),P(A=a,X=x,Y=1))\) are \((3/20,1/10)\), \((1/10,3/20)\), \((7/40,3/40)\), and \((3/40,7/40)\) for \((a,x)=(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)\), respectively.
